title: Shipwrecks of the world, and how many over time
excerpt: Wikipedia lists 243,071 shipwrecks since 1700. I counted them year by year: three of the five worst years are war years, with 1944 the worst. The huge 1800s plateau owes a lot to British newspapers.
seo_description: 243,071 shipwrecks listed on Wikipedia since 1700, counted by year, cause and flag: the world wars, the age of sail and Lloyd's List.
